heading: Exclusive right to name
lead: The corporation and its State, territorial, and local subdivisions have the exclusive right to use the name “American War Mothers”.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 2250536:100.Feb. 24, 1925, ch. 303, § 10, 43 Stat. 968. The words “to have” are omitted as included in “to use”. The words “in carrying out its business purposes” are omitted as unnecessary.
